_comment: When the Remediation Agent may act without a human click (demo). Every condition must hold; otherwise the incident goes to an engineer in Slack as before. The execution policy (execution_policy.json) still applies to every change it makes.

actions._comment: Only these typed actions may be automated. max_attempts includes the first attempt; memory steps multiply by step_factor (rounded up to 64Mi, capped by the execution policy). Restoring configuration always needs a human.
